title: api.ttcstatus.ca pre-flight configuration (security.json)
description: Every route on the pre-flight board: its command, its tools, its state and its baseline time. Managed by ./pre-flight commands; edit by hand freely.

pretty.description: Board rendering: 'auto' picks the pretty board on a TTY and plain logs in CI/pipes; true/false force a style.

parallel.description: Run checks at the same time (default) or one at a time.

output.description: How much check output to print: 'auto' (failures full, passes tailed), 'always', or 'quiet'.

baselineTolerancePct.description: A check is flagged 'delayed' only when it exceeds its baseline by more than this percentage. Delays never fail the run.

toolsDir.description: Where installable tools are placed and PATH-managed. Keep it gitignored.

tools.description: External tools checks may need. Each entry: how to probe for it and how to install it when missing.

probe.description: Cheap command that succeeds when the tool is present.

install.description: Command that installs the tool when the probe fails.

version.description: Pinned version to install and probe for.

sha256.description: Optional pinned archive digests, keyed by platform (linux-x64, darwin-arm64, windows-x64, …).

checks.description: The routes on the board. Key = route id used on the command line.

label.description: Human-readable name shown on the board and in status.

group.description: 'check' routes run for ./pre-flight check; 'build' routes only run on the full board.

enabled.description: Set by ./pre-flight on|off. Disabled routes are skipped everywhere except when named explicitly.

skipNext.description: Set by ./pre-flight skip. Skips exactly one run, then clears itself.

command.description: Shell command to run. '{bin:name}' resolves to the local node_modules binary on any platform. cwd is the repo root and the tools directory is on PATH.

aliases.description: Extra names accepted on the command line.

tools.description: Entries under `tools` that must be present (probed, then installed) before this check runs.

recordedAt.description: ISO date of the last ./pre-flight baseline run.

seconds.description: Route id → seconds a passing run took. Every run reports its +/- % against these.
